ValidationRule.description: Blocks edits to Opportunities already Closed Won/Lost, incl. reopening. Allowed: Edit Closed Opportunities custom permission, or saves changing Closed Won automation fields (so it can finish). Honors On/Off Switch.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Setup.On_Off_Switch__c.Run_Validation_Rules__c && ( TEXT(PRIORVALUE(StageName)) = "Closed Won" || TEXT(PRIORVALUE(StageName)) = "Closed Lost" ) && NOT($Permission.Edit_Closed_Opportunities) && NOT( ISCHANGED(Closed_Won_Automation_Complete__c) || ISCHANGED(Closed_Won_Automation_Error__c) || ISCHANGED(Renewal_Opportunity__c) || ISCHANGED(ContractId) || ISCHANGED(License_Start_Date__c) || ISCHANGED(License_End_Date__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Opportunity is closed and can't be edited. Contact a Beacon Salesforce Admin if it needs to be changed.
